confidence_notes: Food estimates use Koh Samui's Numbeo aggregate, last updated 2026-11-17 with 38 contributors; applying those current prices to the July 2026 window is approximate. Cocktail and wine estimates are inferred relative to draft beer. Accommodation estimates are holistic and subject to island seasonality.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city used; food and drink are based on Koh Samui aggregates, while accommodation is estimated for a tourism-heavy Gulf of Thailand island.
